game.desc: Assassin's Creed IV: Black Flag is an action adventure game for Xbox 360. The player embodies Edward Kenway, a lawless pirate who terrorises the Caribbean in the 18th century. On his ship, the Jackdaw, he can freely explore an area from Florida to Jamaica via Cuba and attack convoys in search of booty. Visits to cities such as Havana and Kingston are also on the agenda, as is a competitive or cooperative multiplayer mode.
